checkpoint_selection: Official synthetic+ChangeSim checkpoint selected before inference because target imagery is indoors.
input_preprocessing: RGB float/255, ImageNet z-score, full branch 520x520 and low branch 256x256; no test augmentation
compatibility: Native PyTorch equivalent of upstream zero-padded 9x9 channel-mean correlation. Original train.py architecture, use_pac=False; no head replaced.
input_source: New registered Gaussian render RGB; no original-photo probability reused
person_policy: Six rendered cube views, YOLO11l-seg person masks OR boxes with 10% margin on each side; union across both epochs
